limitations: Worlds and epochs are fictional and synthetic.
The search is deterministic local refinement after a finite grid, not global proof.
The objective uses ideal impulsive parking-orbit injection and capture.
Operational ephemerides, navigation, finite burns, launch, entry, and landing are excluded.

optimizer.method: complete rectangular grid plus bounded coordinate refinement

safety_scope: Fictional civilian research transfer using synthetic worlds and epochs for education and portfolio verification only; not an operational trajectory.
